notes.title: Playtest 2.0
notes.content:
[h3]Available Now![/h3]
After a long time since the last update, here is a massive update bringing multiplayer to Elite Rogue as well as big map changes. 

[h3]The long awaited multiplayer update is finally here! [/h3]
This means you can team up to explore the updated map and the brand new one [u]out now[/u].
The [b]10 player[/b] multiplayer aims to make the roguelike experience a little different from the norm.

[h3]Map Changes[/h3]
The original map has [b]quadrupled[/b] in size and the update also brings a [b]new map[/b] just as big, this means a lot more to explore and there are also a couple of [i]secret [/i]places to be found!
Our newest map [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2304480/view/4442331835939160526?l=english]Electro Caves[/url] is now ready for the public after a lot of tweaks, with it comes [b]new foes[/b] fitting the theme as well as a [b]brand new boss[/b].

notes.title: Playtest 2.0
notes.content:
[h2]We have connected the maps![/h2]
[list]
[*] The maps have been opened to be bigger : Both the Nightmare Dimension and the brand new Electro Caves have been expanded to 4x the current size of the Nightmare map!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281437/a8f132b4da8b5c9f0158302aaf1f77c6b1ec56f0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281437/5dba82ddbf82d32bb66ae6756baa783502f2bb3e.png[/img]
[*] The update also brings with it secret portals, that take you to secret places: It's a secret so you'll have to find out what they have in store on your own.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281437/db500d4e910c888ec09abfe58c54b23b4d4863f4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281437/aaee8476bc4c88b4805b6034b16a5742580ad066.png[/img]
[*] get ready for playtest 2, we are close.
[/list]
-Void Chamber

notes.title: Development Blog: Electro Caves
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855544/a2ba729727b32c906aa41c13cce82f9a79b3dde9.png[/img]
[i]Lorenzo Tatagila and his goons has built a base in the electro caves. I need YOU to bring Lorenzo down!
-Mr.B 
[/i]
Greetings Voidlings! It has been a long time since our last announcement since our focus has been on developing new and old environments as well as the multiplayer feature. Here is a peek at the new map Electro Caves where Lorenzo Tatagilas goons have been busy building their hideout. This new dimension will bring with it the following content and more: [list]
[*]New dimension with it's own unique theme and content
[*]New enemies
[*]New boss
[*]New player items 
[*]New music
[/list]
[h1]Dimension[/h1]
[i](new)[/i] Electro Caves 
[list]
[*]Tatagila and his goons have been busy building their headquarters over at Electro Caves
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855544/1883a7aab6284a08f232316e48cf3ab790b1a486.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855544/4c6195471098ced7e2ca81761f51964159972441.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855544/8f3a5469fd15856da35663b06fb9c2902f1233b4.png[/img]
[h1][i](new) [/i]Foes[/h1]
[i]Stonk rat[/i]
[list]
[*]This tanky new foe can be found around the kitchen
[*]"what has he been eating?"
[*]A powerful and tanky rat that you have to shoot from afar or you will realise how hard he hits
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855544/98fe6922a1f16d3c7e3464a849298774e58c562a.png[/img]

[i]Bodyguard rat[/i]
[list]
[*]Another heavy unit equipped with military weaponry and an armoured vest
[*]"I don't think he works for the military"
[*]This new plated rat seems dangerous equipped with armour and heavy weapons that your gonna regret messing with
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855544/d70ce9f06379714e08e0ea44ca7720b0b3282af2.png[/img]

[i]Wizardo rat[/i]
[list]
[*]Don't let this skinny magicians looks fool you
[*]"He just scammed me out of 50 bucks!"
[*]This rat street performance artist carries only a magicians wand, looks innocent enough.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855544/d7e802904e903da5f0e2c185cc3a63f172af5783.png[/img]

[i]Gunner rat[/i]
[list]
[*]The most common foe found around Electro caves
[*]Your typical rat goon, most of Tatagilas group concists of these gunners which are weak alone but their strength lies in numbers.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855544/d875b5ce8a33e04aac9b1bfd4922578e0cc66b50.png[/img]

[h1]Items[/h1]
[list]
[*]be on the lookout for new items as well this update!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855544/62c976947987a578d88d07f19de2beca47150000.png[/img]
[h1]Boss[/h1]
[i]new[/i] Lorenzo Tatagila
[list]
[*]Kingpin of the rats
[*]Lorenzo is the leader of the rat goons for a reason as you will find out..
[*]Equipped with two light machine guns he will leave you looking like swiss cheese if you let your guard down during your visit through his domain
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855544/4a38b3d83bcb6d5d0d9a8efbcd7d5b5eeab718ee.png[/img]

Overall the next playtest update will be bringing along a lot of new content and variation, especially for all of the warriors who played Nightmare a bunch of times during the first playtest! Electro Caves exclusively features it's own unique foes and environment which gives the game a completely different vibe, so stay put for the next big update!

Before the big update that will be in the playtest 2.0 we will be updating you on all the major features we have been working on so far. We will also be holding polls and making [i]your[/i] suggestions into reality over on our [url=https://discord.gg/AsVDWyRXmP]discord[/url]. So head on over if you want to choose what is added next!

notes.title: Playtest 2 Multiplayer update coming soon!
notes.content:
[h1]🚀Exciting News: Playtest 2 - Dimensional Jump is on the Horizon![/h1]

We're thrilled to share a sneak peek into our upcoming Playtest 2, featuring the ground-breaking multiplayer update for Elite Rogue! This major update will introduce a dynamic gaming experience, including balanced spawn rates and item drops per player, making your adventures even more thrilling.

[h2]Changes since the first playtest include:[/h2]
[list]
[*] General balancing
[*] Fixed wave system
[*] Fixed difficulty
[*] Major bugfixes
[*] Added missing item models
[*] Added easter eggs
[/list]

But that's not all! We're also working on a spectacular VFX update, enhancing the visual appeal of items and various in-game elements. Stay tuned for more details on this exciting addition!

 [h2]🌟Player Testimonials:[/h2]
Your positive feedback has been our driving force, and we're grateful for your continued support. To share the joy, here are a few testimonials from our dedicated community:

"This is dope af" 
"Very cool to try this game out!" 
"like the game at this early stage!"

 [h2]🤯Behind the Scenes:[/h2]
While we won't delve into the nitty-gritty, creating a seamless multiplayer experience is a colossal task. Our dedicated team is committed to overcoming the complexities, making Elite Rogue the best it can be.

 [h2]👥Multiplayer Highlight:[/h2]
The highlight of the upcoming update? Elite Rogue will support up to 10 players! Experience the thrill of a roguelike adventure like never before. Queue up with friends or go solo — the choice is yours. 

 [h2]📸Sneak Peek:[/h2]
Check out these concept pictures for a glimpse of what Elite Rogue will look like in multiplayer mode! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281437/748b7ea1c2cf397add2dc596acd1055d431ec829.png[/img]

 [h2]🎉Extra Addition Today:[/h2]
Big news! We've implemented a new feature based on your feedback. Now, when you pick up items, a handy popup will display with the description and image of the respective items. 

 [h2]🔜Stay Tuned:[/h2]
The big update is around the corner. Thank you for being a vital part of Elite Rogue's journey. Your feedback has shaped this game, and we can't wait to share these exciting additions with you. Stay tuned for more updates, and get ready for an epic adventure!
